content.text: Very common at 5, and it's a habit that responds well to a calm, boring routine. Tonight, tell Milo the plan before bedtime: he stays in his own bed, and you'll pop in to check on him. When he shows up in your room, walk him back with as little talk as you can, every time, and keep your tone warm and flat. A small reward the next morning when he stays put helps a lot at this age.
